excerpt.zh: 地表上一个庞大的露天市场交易着来自整个星域的商品。乘客们迫不及待地想要去逛一逛并讨价还价。
excerpt.en: A sprawling open-air market on the surface deals in goods from across the sector. The passengers are eager to browse and haggle.
